children: France animal health firm's H1 sales grew 0.7% on reported basis, 3.4% at constant rates
Net income for H1 2026 rose 21.8% yr/yr to 11.8% of sales
Company's growth driven by Essential products and strong U.S. market performance
Vetoquinol did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
ESSENTIALS PRODUCTS - Growth in Essentials products, which now account for two-thirds of sales, supported overall business performance
U.S. MARKET - Strong sales growth in the U.S., up 13.1% in USD, was a key driver for the half-year
PRODUCT MIX AND PRICING - Higher gross margin attributed to increased share of Essentials products and price rises of over 2.5%
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the pharmaceuticals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Vetoquinol SA is €81.50, about 22.6% above its September 9 closing price of €66.50
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
